title: Man Gets Abusive With His Girlfriend On A Plane After Getting Drunk
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 14th, 2023. Officers were called to the airport regarding a man who was physically abusing his girlfriend before boarding and the duration of the flight. Multiple witnesses on the flight stated that the man was extremely belligerent towards her, to the point where he took off his watch and threw it at her. When officers questioned the man, he stated that he had to much to drink and couldn't remember what had happened. When officers had questioned the woman, she said nothing sever had happened and was trying to protect the man, instead of stating what had happened.
